response.text:
Strong sampled separation does not establish useful top-K ranking. A [2024 sequential-recommendation study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17276) found sampler performance depends on dataset popularity structure: random negatives favored head items, while popularity-based sampling improved balance at an overall accuracy cost. [Correcting the LogQ Correction (RecSys 2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09331) revises sampled-softmax importance correction because the positive is always included, rather than sampled. Its uncertainty-weighted formulation is relevant to multi-negative training; sampling-distribution correction does not itself identify false negatives.

[R²NS (WWW 2026)](https://renzhaochun.github.io/assets/pdf/WWW_2026_Camera_Ready.pdf) provides a practical curriculum: uniform-negative warm-up, efficient global candidate recall, then stochastic selection from a progressively narrower top-M pool. This avoids introducing maximum-hardness negatives before representations stabilize. The paper explicitly recognizes that highest-scoring unseen items may be potential positives; stochastic top-M sampling mitigates that risk without establishing negative labels. [Scalable Cross-Entropy (RecSys 2024)](https://dspace.mit.edu/entities/publication/5392aca9-0bae-4176-9b3a-a8165957ba26) offers another route: approximate catalog cross-entropy using informative candidates retrieved through maximum-inner-product search.

Practical synthesis for one NextItNet predictor: compare multi-negative sampled softmax against the baseline, then introduce a gradual mixture of uniform and stochastically selected hard negatives. Exclude known training positives and investigate conservative downweighting of uncertain negatives rather than treating every unseen item as dislike. Keep proposal-probability correction distinct from false-negative handling. These are experimental hypotheses, not guaranteed improvements: select by fixed macro validation HR@10, since lower training loss or larger sampled margins cannot establish transfer to the pinned ranking task.
